title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasthuri insists on practising dance with Karthik while he rehearses with Priya, revealing her jealousy. Later, Priya questions Karthik about his bond with Kasthuri.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani and Pavithra get ready for the baby shower while Rajeshwari taunts Kanmani and blocks Kaveri and Sarasu at the entrance. Anbu immediately objects and stands up for them.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Shruthi remains firm despite Sudha's plea after the insult towards Ravi. Rohini, Shruthi, and Meena approach Parvathy, hoping to establish their event business at her house.
